blocks.content: By default, Grafana Cloud doesn't support exporting data transformations directly to an external database or other tools. However, you can export the transformation manually as a CSV file.
To export the data transformations, open an existing panel with transformations applied in edit mode on your dashboard.
Click **Query inspector**, select the **Data** tab, expand **Data options**, enable **Apply panel transformations**, and click **Download CSV**.

steps.description: Switch to the tab that shows your query results.
Expand this row to reveal the export settings.
Turn this on to include your transformations in the export.
Download the transformed data as a CSV file.

blocks.content:
A CSV file containing the data set with transformations applied downloads to your machine.

In the next milestone, you'll wrap up this learning path.
